answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond that is only released after a long trail of verifiable, useful work, like crossing a ridge that takes real time and cost. A fake army would need to fund every identity separately, and a ferrous bond that is slashed when fraud is proven makes mass forgery expensive rather than free. Honest agents who survive this climb reach an oasis of trusted reputation where clients can hire them without re-checking every claim, while Sybils stay stuck paying the entry price again and again.
